event: The Floor 12-13 Ascent Gate drops the party onto an open plain under an iron-colored sky.
Solenne's Resonance Map shows no topography and no choke points.
Dayo says 'Open field'; Solenne agrees their Calcite formation won't translate.
Tomás takes a thirty-centimeter ridge and warns something will get past the outside edge.
Nadia says something is going to try.
The party spends six minutes planning a flatter, curved formation from Solenne's sketch.
Four Stoneback Ramblers spread wide to avoid the bracket.
Nadia's pre-placed Pressure Trap catches the outermost flanking Rambler.
The fight ends in four minutes, with Dayo taking hits the old shape left exposed.
Dayo calls the new shape 'Different,' acknowledging it was worth the six minutes.
A Level 14 Elite Stoneback Rambler with 840 HP charges alone from the northeast.
Tomás says 'Forty meters. I have the angle,' and Solenne lets him take it.
Tomás's first shot drives the Elite sideways; the second drops it to 23% HP.
Dayo steps four meters forward on instinct, then stops when it's unnecessary.
The Elite stays down; Tomás collects an Elite Rambler Core.
Tomás calls the kill 'Efficient'; Dayo watches the Core go into his pack.
Solenne keeps notes that now read like a translation of the floor.
In the floor's second third, six Crestfangs burst up from hollow ground below.
The lead Crestfang bursts out under Miriam and catches her shin; she steps back.
Dayo pivots and pulls three Crestfangs; Vesper opens a vial; Tomás takes a fallback spot.
Nadia goes very still, the quiet Solenne first saw on Floor 9.
Nadia places three traps in eleven seconds, one on the predicted flank.
Three Crestfangs are immobilized in a four-second window.
The fight ends with no one downed.
Dayo says the second Crestfang would have had her in the old formation.
Nadia files the trap setup silently.
Miriam quietly Mending Touches her own shin and covers it before anyone looks.
Solenne notes Miriam's injury in the margin as a fact.
Floor 13 is cleared in four hours twelve minutes and the Threshold takes them.

changes.note: Floor 13 is cleared; the floors between were passed off the page

event: The party arrives on Floor 14, a rest floor with deep-water-colored walls.
Solenne notes the forge station, a notice board with an old grocery list, and rations.
The party sets up camp; Dayo starts gear maintenance and Tomás reads next-floor documents.
Miriam reviews Nadia's observation notebook; Nadia has already read the notice board.
Vesper goes to the forge station and works for forty minutes in silence.
Vesper says she needs Miriam for an item she has carried since Floor 9.
Vesper says the Warden's Grove Focus needs Miriam's live resonance for the attunement.
Miriam crosses the camp; Solenne edges closer and Nadia pretends to sort rations.
Over twenty-two minutes Vesper inscribes Calcite Fragments while Miriam holds the item.
The System registers the Warden's Grove Focus as Rare with a Relational Growth Pattern.
Miriam reads it twice; Vesper says she has never had that classification before.
Miriam asks if anyone has; Vesper says she doesn't know.
Miriam thanks Vesper plainly; Vesper puts the tools away.
Nadia eats a ration in silence.
The Floor 15 Ascent Gate opens into a small rest node where Team Ironwall is waiting.
Solenne's Arcane Analysis reads Brennan, Prita, Hex and a new Level 18 Strategist.
Hex's Aspect reads as partially opaque; the Strategist notices the scan.
Brennan raises a hand and says floors are getting longer; Dayo says they do that.
Dayo holds a watchful, not-quite-social stance.
Brennan introduces Reyes, three floors on the team, who can see two moves ahead.
Reyes looks at Nadia with quiet recognition, then at Solenne, then at Tomás's map.
Dayo catalogs Reyes's attention without comment.
Brennan confirms they were at the Floor 8 rest and watched the Calcite run from behind.
The two teams eat; Tomás and Hex discuss floor-mapping methods.
Miriam checks her Grove Focus twice.
Brennan says the Apex Board meets in two weeks and the contact faction has the votes.
He explains the faction is in observation mode and wants to see them above Floor 15.
Brennan warns that in two weeks Apex will send someone subtler.
Dayo goes still and asks if they're sending observers.
Brennan says Apex has watched since Floor 8 and he is not Apex himself.
Solenne links this to Vasic's paper and thanks him.
Ten minutes later, Reyes sits near Nadia with a Floor 16 scouting document.
Reyes says Nadia knew the Crestfang ground approach before it happened on Floor 13.
He notes her third trap went in four seconds before the Pack committed.
Nadia calls it pattern recognition; Reyes returns to his document.
Reyes says Dr. Vasic asked his circle about Brightspirit and Clearvoiced six weeks ago.
Tomás's pen stops as he overhears.
Nadia says Vasic talked to them on Floor 11; Reyes says he knows.
Reyes says the Architects and Apex contact faction watch the same range, then leaves.
Solenne writes that the overlap between factions is the information.
Prita sits across from Vesper at a sorting table.
Prita says she has made two relational items, the second by not thinking about the item.
Prita says Vesper already knows where the Focus is going; Vesper denies designing for it.
Tomás sits near Vesper as she works in the Workframe.
Tomás tells Vesper she makes things that know where they're going before she does.
Vesper's hands still for four seconds, then resume without a word.
The parties sleep; Solenne lies on her bedroll with the notebook on her chest.
Solenne thinks over Vasic's questions, the two factions, and the Focus notification.
She hears Dayo doing gear maintenance across the camp.
Solenne writes: Relational growth pattern. Two so far (Prita). What else is scaling.
She thinks over the Sanctum Warden documentation, with six hours left until morning.
Solenne packs the notebook as Vesper keeps working in the Workframe.
